mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course (name, description, price, duration, status, category_id, coach_id, max_participants, image) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{price}, #{duration}, #{status}, #{categoryId}, #{coachId}, #{maxParticipants}, #{image})
mapper.update: UPDATE course SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, price = #{price}, duration = #{duration}, status = #{status}, category_id = #{categoryId}, coach_id = #{coachId}, max_participants = #{maxParticipants}, image = #{image} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE course SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT c.*, cat.title as category_name, coach.coach as coach_name, coach.name as coach_position FROM course c LEFT JOIN category cat ON c.category_id = cat.id LEFT JOIN coach ON c.coach_id = coach.id WHERE c.id = #{id}

SELECT c.*, cat.title as category_name, coach.coach as coach_name, coach.name as coach_position FROM course c LEFT JOIN category cat ON c.category_id = cat.id LEFT JOIN coach ON c.coach_id = coach.id WHERE c.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY c.create_time DESC

SELECT c.*, cat.title as category_name, coach.coach as coach_name, coach.name as coach_position FROM course c LEFT JOIN category cat ON c.category_id = cat.id LEFT JOIN coach ON c.coach_id = coach.id WHERE c.coach_id = #{coachId} ORDER BY c.create_time DESC

SELECT c.*, cat.title as category_name, coach.coach as coach_name, coach.name as coach_position FROM course c LEFT JOIN category cat ON c.category_id = cat.id LEFT JOIN coach ON c.coach_id = coach.id WHERE c.category_id = #{categoryId} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY c.create_time DESC
